title: a seat file
description: One seat of the factory, in seats/<seat>.yaml: who it is, where and on what it runs, what it is told, how it starts, and what it may use.

seat.description: The seat's id: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters. It equals the file's name without .yaml.

name.description: The seat's display name. Must not be blank.

role.description: The seat's role word. Must not be blank.

line.description: The production line the seat works on. Must not be blank.

machine.description: The machine the seat runs on; when absent, the factory's default machine. Must not be blank.

agent.description: The agent the seat runs; when absent, the factory's default agent.

model.description: The model the seat runs; when absent, the factory's default model. Must not be blank.

repository.description: The repository the seat works in, one of the factory's repositories, with no spaces. Absent means no repository.

brief.description: What the seat is told to do. Must not be blank.

starts.description: How the seat starts: each start is a time (cron) or an interval (every), with a prompt.

items.title: a start
items.description: One way the seat starts. Exactly one of cron or every.

cron.description: A five-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday), as schedules take. Needs timeZone.

timeZone.description: The time zone the cron expression is read in. Required with cron, not allowed with every.

every.description: An interval: a whole number followed by s, m or h, such as 10m. Needs a check.

check.description: The check that decides whether the seat starts: a path checks/<name>.py in this definition. Required with every.

secrets.description: The secret names the check gets, each once. Only allowed with a check.

items.description: A secret's name, with no spaces.

prompt.description: What the seat is told when this start fires. Must not be blank.

preventOverlap.description: Whether a start waits while the seat's last run is still going. Default true; cannot be false on a start with a check.

grants.description: The grants the seat uses, by id in grants.yaml, each once.

items.description: A grant id: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

rules.description: The rule sets the seat takes, by name (rules/<name>.json), each once.

items.description: A rule set name: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

secrets.description: The secret names the seat needs at start, each once.

items.description: A secret's name, with no spaces.

skills.title: a seat's skills
skills.description: The skills the seat gets: the factory's own and fleet skills, by name.

factory.description: Factory skills by name (skills/<name>/SKILL.md in this definition), each once.

items.description: A factory skill name: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

fleet.description: Fleet skills by id, from the account's skill store, each once.

items.description: A fleet skill id, with no spaces.

files.description: The files the seat needs, by path under files/ in this definition, each once.

items.description: A path in this definition that begins files/.
